MINISTRY OF CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION 
(Department of Food and Public Distribution) 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 18th June, 2021 
G.S.R. 420(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (e) of sub-section (2) of section 39 
of the National Food Security Act, 2013 (20 of 2013), the Central Government hereby makes the following 
rules to amend the Food Security (Assistance to State Governments) Rules, 2015, namely:- 
1. 
(1) These rules may be called the Food Security (Assistance to State Governments) (Amendment) Rules, 
2021, 
(2) 
They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2. 
In the Food Security (Assistance to State Governments) Rules, 2015, in rule 7, in sub-rule (2) after 
the words “its running expenses and incentive for its use”, the words “and any savings if accrued could be 
utilized for purchase, operations and maintenance of electronic weighing scales and their integration with 
the Point of Sale device” shall be inserted. 
[F. No. 15-18/2021-NFSA] 
MANISHA SENSARMA, Economic Adviser 
Note: 
The principal rules was published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary Part-II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (1) vide Notification number G.S.R. 636 (E), dated the 17th August, 2015.
